annotations.title: Attach a file for App Review

description: Uploads a file for Apple's reviewers to the App Store version being prepared, beside the review notes: a demo video of a flow they can't reach (hardware, a paid account, a location), or a document (from an absolute path on this machine, up to 500 MB). It goes to App Store Connect straight away, not as a draft; while the version is with App Review, Ploa keeps it and sends it once Apple has decided (files over 60 MB can't wait: send them again then). ploa_details_get step review lists the attachments with their ids. Needs a token allowed to submit.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.
